verdict.rationale: Numeral's API explicitly supports adding refunds to transactions and reversing refunds (numeral-docs-28, numeral-docs-29), and refunds/transactions feed into Numeral's automated filing and liability tracking pipeline (numeral-docs-11, numeral-docs-18, numeral-docs-34), implying no manual journal entries are needed. However, there's no explicit documentation on how negative amounts specifically adjust reported liability figures, no mention of 'credit notes' terminology, and no confirmation that refunds automatically reconcile in the next filing period. Missing for 10: explicit credit-note support, documented liability/reporting adjustment mechanics for negative amounts, and confirmation refunds auto-reconcile in the subsequent filing without manual intervention.
